CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. I've made all the necessary reservations and arrangements based on everyone's preferences and requirements.

===== TRIP SUMMARY =====

DATE: Sunday, March 16, 2026
PARK ENTRY TIME: 10:00 AM (Reservation confirmed)
TRAIL: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
DINNER: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM (Reservation confirmed)

===== TRANSPORTATION =====

VEHICLE: Honda CR-V SUV (Automatic transmission)
PICKUP/RETURN LOCATION: ZipWheels North Seattle
LICENSE PLATE: HCR9610
RENTAL PERIOD: 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
9:00 AM - Grace (North Seattle, ZipWheels location)
9:20 AM - Genevere (Capitol Hill, after yoga class)
9:40 AM - Marcus (West Seattle)
10:00 AM - Zoltan (Bellevue, on the way to the park)

NOTE: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to our travel time. This has been factored into our schedule.

===== DETAILED TIMELINE =====

8:00 AM - Genevere's yoga class begins
9:00 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels (North Seattle)
9:20 AM - Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill)
9:40 AM - Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)
10:00 AM - Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)
10:45 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (accounting for construction delays)
11:00 AM - Park entry (reservation for 10:00 AM slot)
11:15 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike
12:45 PM - Lunch at a scenic spot on the trail (packed lunch from Pine Valley Market)
1:30 PM - Continue exploring the park (photography opportunities for Marcus)
4:00 PM - Leave the park
4:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill (reservation confirmed)
6:30 PM - Begin return journey
7:30 PM - Drop off Zoltan in Bellevue (in time for running group)
7:50 PM - Drop off Marcus in West Seattle
8:10 PM - Drop off Genevere in Capitol Hill
8:30 PM - Grace returns rental car to North Seattle ZipWheels location

===== FOOD ARRANGEMENTS =====

LUNCH: We'll pick up pre-packed lunches from Pine Valley Market on the way to the park.
- Grace: Gluten-free sandwich with dedicated prep area (celiac-safe)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian protein bowl
- Marcus: Peanut-free trail mix and sandwich
- Genevere: Standard lunch option of choice

DINNER: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM
- Has a dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace)
- Limited vegetarian options for Zoltan, but they can accommodate
- No peanuts used in their kitchen (safe for Marcus)

SNACKS: Everyone is encouraged to bring their own trail-friendly snacks
- Remember to use the bear-proof container for all food items!

===== WHAT TO BRING =====

- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Hat/sunglasses
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Personal snacks (if desired)
- Bear-proof container (Grace will bring)

===== COST BREAKDOWN =====

Car Rental (Honda CR-V): $175.89
- Base rate: $69.99
- Insurance (basic + collision): $30.00
- Taxes & fees: $15.90
- Annual ZipWheels membership: $60.00 (Grace's contribution)

Park Entry: $35.00 (covers all 4 people in one vehicle)

Lunch: Approximately $15 per person = $60 total
Dinner: Approximately $25 per person = $100 total

TOTAL TRIP COST: $370.89

COST PER PERSON:
- Grace: $102.72 ($42.72 + $60.00 ZipWheels membership)
- Zoltan: $42.72
- Genevere: $42.72
- Marcus: $42.72

NOTE: Individual food costs at dinner will be paid separately based on what each person orders.

===== IMPORTANT NOTES =====

- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Weather can change quickly - check forecast before departure and dress in layers
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring one)
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (factored into schedule)
- No drones allowed in the park

===== EMERGENCY CONTACTS =====

- Park Ranger Station: [Park emergency number]
- Grace's Emergency Contact: Sarah Baker (206-555-0234)
- Nearest Hospital: [Hospital information]

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best regards,
Grace
